reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name
FROM promotions pr
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE pr.promo_code = 'P-2025-05'
alternatives: SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id WHERE pr.promo_code = 'P-2025-05'

WITH covered AS (SELECT pp.product_id FROM promotion_products pp JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id WHERE pr.promo_code = 'P-2025-05') SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM covered cv JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cv.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
